info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Careers Applications Interviews-v4-spec
info.description: The Career Interview Management API facilitates the retrieval of interview details for job applications. This endpoint allows users to obtain comprehensive information regarding scheduled interviews, their statuses, and associated applicants. Typical consumers include HR professionals and hiring managers who need to manage and track interview processes effectively. By providing easy access to interview information, this API supports streamlined communication and decision-making in the recruitment workflow.

get.description: This endpoint allows developers to retrieve a list of interview applications submitted in the system. It provides detailed information about each application, facilitating effective management and decision-making processes.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving interview application details. This request must include the necessary parameters to specify the criteria for fetching the relevant interview applications.

ListCareersApplicationsInterviewsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to applications and interviews. It should contain a string value.

ListCareersApplicationsInterviewsRespons.title: Interview Application Response

status.description: Indicates whether the application process was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique identifier for tracking the application.

resultId.description: Identifier representing the result of the interview process.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the application in milliseconds.

message.description: Additional message related to the application process.

audit.description: Details about the audit trail for the application.

ListCareersApplicationsInterviewsRespons.description: Schema representing the response for the interview application operation.

AuditDetails.title: Audit Details

createdBy.description: Identifier of the user who created the audit entry.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the audit entry was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the application was processed automatically.

AuditDetails.description: Schema representing the audit details of the application.

x-processing-time.description: The time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds. This value helps clients understand the performance of the operation.
